beats.text: Signing up takes about a minute, and the free tier is a genuine one — a brand, twenty-five creators, a seat. Enough to actually run a campaign, not a trial that quietly expires on you. And that spreadsheet you've been living in? Just drop it in. It'll work out which columns are your creators and which are campaign details, and show you what it's found before it touches anything.

Every campaign gets a board. And this is the nice part — it isn't another tracker to keep in sync. Move the page, the card moves with it. Drag the card, the page follows. One truth, two views, and nothing to reconcile on a Friday afternoon.

Now here's the thing the spreadsheet could never do for you. Every creator gets their own code, and the moment someone orders with it, that sale is theirs. So when you ask what a partnership was really worth, there's an answer waiting — per creator, over whatever window you care about. And paying them follows from the very same number. Approve what's owed, record that you've paid it, and it's closed off against the work they did.

Some campaigns you just need out the door. So describe it — the goal, the offer, who it's for — and you'll get a page back, built from sections that already work. Rewrite every word if you want to; you genuinely can't break the design, because there's nothing in here that sets a colour or a position. Add the coupon, hit publish, and it's live with the tracking already wired in.

Or hand it to the creator, which is where this gets good. One click, and they get a link — not an account to set up, not a password to forget. It opens on their phone with your product already in it. They make it sound like them, and send it back. It arrives in your list under waiting on you, you read what they changed, and you publish. They can't — that stays with you, always. Then they get their own link and their own code, and they share it with their audience in their own words. Every sale that comes through it is theirs.
And both paths land in the same place. What each creator brought in, what they're owed, and what you've already paid them. No guessing at the end of the month.
